name: hero-kapadokya
usedIn: Ana sayfa hero videosu (tam genişlik, metin sol altta; mobilde 4:5 ortadan kırpılır)

decisions.yapı: 6 plan (3+2+3+2+2+3 = 15 sn), planlar yön, ışık ve tozla bağlı; finalize'da 0.4 sn geçişler ve döngü dikişi

style: Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Vision3 250D, fine natural grain, soft halation, warm earthy palette of ochre, rust and dry gold, low golden-hour autumn sun, gentle natural camera motion, 24fps, cinematic, calm. No people, no text, no logos, no hot air balloons, no vehicles, no modern buildings.

shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the Cappadocia valley at golden hour, fairy chimneys and tuff ridges, long shadows on dry steppe, slow dolly forward drifting right.
Low aerial glide over fairy chimney tops toward a golden grass plain, camera moving right, a trail of dust rising in the distance.
Wild horses gallop left to right across a golden grass plain beneath tuff cliffs, backlit dust in the low sun, smooth tracking shot moving right.
Close-up of dry golden grass swaying as drifting dust settles, strong backlight, shallow depth of field, slow drift right, no animals.
Carved stone doorway of an old cave dwelling, warm low sun raking across rough tuff, dust motes in the light, slow push in.
Static wide shot, the sun touching the valley ridge in the center of frame, warm amber light on fairy chimneys, the lower left falls into soft shadow.
